member.name: F:Meziantou.Framework.Json.Internals.JsonPathEvaluator.MaxRecursionDepth
member.summary: Maximum node depth visited by a descendant segment or a deep equality comparison. Both walks are recursive, so an unbounded depth would overflow the stack, which cannot be caught and terminates the process. It also terminates cycles, which a custom may expose. The value leaves ample room above the default of 64 that bounds any document produced by System.Text.Json's own parsers.

member.name: T:Meziantou.Framework.Json.Internals.NormalizedPath
member.summary: Holds the components of a matched node's normalized path and renders them on first use.
member.remarks: Evaluation produces one of these per match, but most callers only read Value on some of them — often none at all, as with EvaluateValue.
